text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, technetium tc 99m pyrophosphate has been on FDA's shortage list for 34 months. Corvale East holds 22 vials (11.9MG/10ML SDV), covering 7.8 days of use.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows Curium US LLC and Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Inc. have been on allocation since 2023-12-27. A Class II recall by Curium US, LLC for lack of assurance of sterility and improper crimps on vials started 2024-11-26, 335 days after FDA posted the shortage. The product label names Curium US LLC plants in Maryland Heights as the manufacturer.

Our position: Current inventory is insufficient. Alternative suppliers not on FDA's shortage list are available. No clinical changes are proposed; dosing decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Cardinal Health 414, LLC (not on FDA shortage list; label names no identifiable plant). Requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with Jubilant DraxImage Inc (not on FDA shortage list; label names no identifiable plant). Requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to place orders with Jubilant DraxImage Inc., dba Jubilant Radiopharma (not on FDA shortage list; label names no identifiable plant). Requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to place orders with Jubilant Draximage (USA) Inc. (not on FDA shortage list; label names no identifiable plant). Requires buyer approval.
5. Buyer to place orders with Lantheus Medical Imaging, Inc. (not on FDA shortage list; plants include Institut National des Radioelements, NTP RADIOISOTOPES, ANSTO, and Lantheus Medical Imaging, Inc.). Requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No action that would delay procurement from the listed alternative suppliers.
